'''Meir Bialer''' ({{Langx|he|מאיר ביאלר}}; born January 30, 1948) is an Israeli pharmacologist who is a David H. Eisenberg Emeritus (active) Professor of Pharmacy at the School of Pharmacy, Faculty of Medicine, of the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]].

== Biography ==
Bialer was born in [[Petach Tikva]], Israel, to a Jewish family. He completed his service in the [[Israeli Army]] in 1971-73.{{citation needed|date=May 2022}}

He received his [[B.Sc.]] Pharm in Pharmacy in 1969, his [[M.Sc.]] in [[Medicinal Chemistry]] from [[The Hebrew University of Jerusalem]] in 1971, his [[MBA]] in 1976 and his [[PhD]] in Medicinal Chemistry from the same university in 1977, with a dissertation on "Antiviral Structure-Activity Relationship of Distamycin and its Derivatives."{{citation needed|date=May 2022}}

After post-doctoral studies at the [[University of Florida]] (1977–79) and [[University of Kentucky]] (1979–80), he became a Lecturer (1980–84) and then Senior Lecturer (1984–88) and then Associate Professor (1988–93) at the School of Pharmacy, Faculty of Medicine, The Hebrew University of Jerusalem. In 1993 he became a Full Professor at the School of Pharmacy, Faculty of Medicine, The Hebrew University of Jerusalem. Currently, he is serving as a David H. Eisenberg Emeritus (active) Professor at the School of Pharmacy, Faculty of Medicine, The Hebrew University of Jerusalem.<ref>{{cite web |title=Professor Meir Bialer |url=https://medicine.ekmd.huji.ac.il/en/research/meirb/Pages/default.aspx |website=The Hebrew University of Jerusalem}}</ref>

Bialer was president of the Israel League Against [[Epilepsy]], a branch of the [[International League Against Epilepsy]] (ILAE), from 1996 to 2001, and as the chair of ILAE-Europe from 2009 to 2017.<ref>{{cite web |title=Israeli League Against Epilepsy |url=https://www.ilae.org/regions-and-countries/national-chapters/israel |website=International League Against Epilepsy |language=en}}</ref> He also served as president of Israel Society of Clinical Pharmacy and Biopharmaceutics (ISCPB), a member of the European Society of Pharmaceutical Sciences (EUFEPS) (1991–2001).

==Research work==
Bialer’s research interests include:
# [[Pharmacokinetics]] of new [[antiepileptic drugs]] (AEDs) and pharmacokinetic-based design of new antiepileptics and CNS drugs.<ref>{{cite web |title=Licensing arrangement reached for HU antiepileptic drug |url=https://www.jpost.com/business/business-features/licensing-arrangement-reached-for-hu-antiepileptic-drug |website=The Jerusalem Post |date=5 September 2006 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Brinn |first1=David |title=More effective epilepsy treatment coming out of Israel |url=https://www.israel21c.org/more-effective-epilepsy-treatment-coming-out-of-israel/ |website=ISRAEL21c |date=17 September 2006}}</ref> In this regard he has been utilizing structure pharmacokinetic [[pharmacodynamic]] relationship (SPPR) studies to design and develop new CNS drugs with better potency, lack of [[teratogenicity]], and a wide safety margin;
# Pharmacokinetic analysis of new drugs, sustained release dosage forms, and novel drug delivery systems (DDS);
# [[Stereospecific]] pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic analysis of [[chiral drugs]];<ref>{{cite web |title=Epilepsie: Gute Aussichten für therapieresistente Patienten |url=https://www.pharmazeutische-zeitung.de/2017-06/epilepsie-gute-aussichten-fuer-therapieresistente-patienten/ |website=Pharmazeutische Zeitung |language=de}}</ref>
# [[Pharmacogenetics]] of CNS drugs;
# Pharmacoresistance to AEDs.<ref>{{cite web |title=Monotherapy Failure and New AEDs on the Horizon |url=https://www.hcplive.com/view/monotherapy_failure_and_new_aeds_on_the_horizon |website=HCPLive |language=en}}</ref>

In these areas, he has 264 peer-reviewed publications, and is an author of 16 book chapters. Since 1981 he has supervised 22 MSc students and 31 PhD students.

== Awards ==
*A Fellow of the American Association of Pharmaceutical Sciences - AAPS (1992)<ref>{{cite web |title=AAPS Fellows List |url=https://www.aaps.org/pharmsci/awards/list |website=American Association of Pharmaceutical Scientists |language=en}}</ref>
*Kaye Innovation Awards at The Hebrew University of Jerusalem (2000, 2006, and 2007)<ref>{{cite web |title=THE KAYE INNOVATION AWARDS |url=https://www.cfhu.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/The-Kaye-Innovation-Awards-2020.pdf |website=Hebrew University of Jerusalem}}</ref>
*Ambassador for Epilepsy Award of The [[International League Against Epilepsy]] – ILLAE and The International Bureau for Epilepsy (IBE; 2001)<ref>{{cite web |title=Ambassador for Epilepsy Award |url=https://www.ilae.org/about-ilae/awards/ambassador-for-epilepsy-award/meir-bialer-2001 |website=International League Against Epilepsy}}</ref>
*European Epileptology Award (2022)<ref>{{cite web |title=European Epileptology Award |url=https://www.ilae.org/about-ilae/awards/european-epileptology-award |website=International League Against Epilepsy}}</ref>

== Personal life==
{{BLP unreferenced section|date=March 2023}}
Meir married Shoshana Novak in 1970. They have two children Michal Bialer-Mor Yosef and Oded Bialer, as well as five grandchildren: Adi, Omri and Roni Bialer and Adam and Eitan Mor Yosef.
